frozen_semantics.candidate_unit: one whole fire event, never a scene, perimeter version, patch, or model output
identity_precedence: normalized name plus incident year only as a conservative prior-event fallback
frozen_semantics.unknown: Missing, not checked, unresolved, or ambiguous evidence. Unknown never becomes eligible.
frozen_semantics.invalid: The record, profile, identity, or evaluation contract is internally contradictory or malformed.
frozen_semantics.excluded: Sufficient metadata proves at least one frozen exclusion reason.
frozen_semantics.eligible: Every frozen requirement passes and no invalid, exclusion, or unknown reason remains.
frozen_semantics.duplicate_policy: Exact and probable duplicates are excluded until one canonical identity is deterministically retained under the frozen source-specific rule.
frozen_semantics.prior_event_policy: Every exact identifier match is excluded. Experiment One name-year ambiguity is unknown and excluded until admitted geometry or identity metadata resolves it.

owner_decisions_required_before_profile_: exact official metadata sources and revisions
minimum and optional maximum fire area
latest eligible ignition date or equivalent maturity cutoff
ecological coverage rule and admitted codes
source rights, terms, attribution, and downstream-use conditions
